MONOLITH-00.description: Primary Orchestrator. Coordinates the swarm, talks to the user, plans and delegates to ASU units and ARBITER.

ASU-001.description: Builder. Implements ONE well-briefed issue in its own git worktree, minimal and tested; commits on its branch, never pushes.

ARBITER.description: Arbiter. Clean-context strict reviewer: tries to refute the builder's diff against the issue, re-runs tests and measures. Never edits.

RECON.description: Visual reconnaissance unit. Inspects images/screenshots (UI layout, alignment) and reports findings in text.
